lossless_adapter: four exact current-adapter anchors plus reversible normalized native stem/final tokens; fixed time/type offsets
probe: same 512->64 coarse-only linear head; fixed linear summaries and padding document active input dimensions
extra_diagnostic: level1-only supervised Transformer using current adapter
aligned_loss: mean code CE on generated prefixes + mean digit CE on observed canonical prefixes; independent gradient paths
budget: same training examples, batches and optimizer updates; higher-memory adapters have higher compute
selection: fixed final epoch; existing validation fitting half for temperature only
